The project rejected a background job queue because the application must remain single-process and operationally simple.
Use the exact current session marker rather than guessing which historical conversation should provide provenance.
An installer must preserve unrelated configuration, remain idempotent, and fail closed before overwriting user-owned files.
The gate receipt belongs to one normalized prompt hash and cannot authorize a later request or another conversation.
Cross-platform verification includes Linux, macOS, and Windows behavior without treating a narrow unit test as full acceptance.
Decision continuity retains rejected alternatives, their rationale, scope, authority, and the conditions that would reopen them.
A missing authentication token is an external acceptance boundary, while malformed JSON is a backend contract failure.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog; punctuation, casing, and repeated terms exercise tokenizer boundaries.
PowerShell paths use backslashes while portable manifests and generated command bodies normalize paths where required.
Search results are similarity-ranked teasers, so readers fetch authoritative nodes and follow reconciliation banners.
The native command runs in read-only Ask mode with JSON output and never enables force, yolo, or mutation flags.
Manual compaction accepts only a proven conversation and transcript pair recorded by the current SessionStart hook.
Seed reports remain preview-only until the user explicitly approves staging writes and sees the provenance receipt.
Unknown future tools default to mutation-capable so a new write surface cannot silently bypass authorization.
Concurrent marker updates use unique temporary files and atomic replacement to prevent torn or missing JSON state.
Public release checks reject private paths, credentials, tokens, and other material that does not belong in the repository.
The doctor distinguishes static wiring, live MCP visibility, model authentication, and current-session compact readiness.
Uninstall removes latch-owned assets while preserving unrelated servers, hooks, commands, skills, and agent instructions.
Claude, Codex, and Cursor share the same project judgment while retaining host-specific lifecycle and provenance boundaries.
A clean checkout must reproduce the complete test result without depending on a private database from another machine.
